liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (3 reviews): Reviewer says this Sugaree never quite takes off the way it can; Reviewer calls Sugaree worthy and powerful [9][10][14]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (3 reviews): Reviewer finds the Scarlet>Fire pairing fabulous; During Scarlet>Fire the audience tape sounds almost like a soundboard [12][13][14]
- **Dancin' In The Streets** (2 reviews): The band stretches out, and Garcia brings out the wah-wah pedal; Dancin' closes the first set with sizzling energy [9][14]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Garcia is nearly the only one speaking musically; the others sound oddly hesitant [10]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Other One is described as burning the joint down [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-05-05.sbd.miller.fishmanj-repitch.78748.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 171 min; rated 3.67/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard mix is excellent, with pitch correction applied by fishmanj [20]
- **gd1979-05-05.sbd.miller.34557.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 178 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: Cassette transfer introduces some azimuth problems [2]
- **gd1979-05-05.123001.mtx.dusborne.flac.16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 17 songs; 174 min; rated 4.78/5 by 9 [3]
- **gd1979-05-05.177537.nak700.glassberg.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 17 songs; 170 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd79-05-05.glassberg.vernon.18871.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 167 min; rated 3.33/5 by 6 [6]. Said about its sound: Sound problems, both at the show and on this audience tape, dull the effect of Jack Straw; First-set audience sound seems soft or low; the second set sounds notably better, perhaps after a taper adjustment [10][13]
- **gd1979-05-05.sonyecm.walker-scotton-miller.89056.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 167 min; rated 4.5/5 by 6 [7]. Said about its sound: Audience recording has good quality, roughly B+, and conveys an intimate sense of being there [15]

## Around the show

- After the show, someone poured day-glo paint over a police car's roof light outside the Civic Center; a crowd gathered and photographed it [17]
- After the show, someone poured day-glo paint over a police car's roof light outside the Civic Center; a crowd gathered and photographed it [19]
- Third consecutive show of Brent's first run; Scarlet>Fire worked out kinks from his first show [12]
- Post-Egypt, Garcia was playing more speedy noodling, which this show captures well [18]
- Ranked with 1979.10.26 and 11.9 among the few great Brent-era shows [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-05-05.sbd.miller.fishmanj-repitch.78748.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller & fishmanj; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat (44.1k) [1]. Also: Miller's soundboard FLACs were speed-corrected by 3% in Cool Edit, using the Glassberg audience tape as baseline; Glassberg's audience source: Nakamichi 700, cassette master, then DAT, then CD; Patches fill gaps in Jack Straw, It's All Over Now, Tennessee Jed, Scarlet Begonias and Samson And Delilah [1]
- **gd1979-05-05.sbd.miller.34557.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat (44.1k) [2]. Also: Glassberg's Nakamichi 700 audience source went cassette master to DAT to CD, patching soundboard gaps; David Gans supplied the soundboard [2]
- **gd1979-05-05.123001.mtx.dusborne.flac.16**: transferred by matrix by dusborne; source: Matrix with Soundboard (shnid:78748): Original Miller FLACs>WAV>Cool Edit 2k (using Pitch->Stretch functions correcting speed by 3%. Used Glassberg audience as… [3]. Also: Show recorded by Barry Glassberg, Robert Wagner and Joani Walker; soundboard came from David Gans [3]
- **gd1979-05-05.177537.nak700.glassberg.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by Bob Menke, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Barry Glassberg's Master Audience Cassettes: Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-158SD (Maxell UDXL II) [4]. Also: A Sony ECM-250 source from Walker, Scotton and Miller supplies a 12-second patch in Drums [4]
- **gd79-05-05.glassberg.vernon.18871.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by John Steinthal; source: Audience Recording [6]
- **gd1979-05-05.sonyecm.walker-scotton-miller.89056.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Sony ECM-250 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-158/Maxell UDXL-II90) [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.deadlistening.com: [1979 May 5 - Baltimore Civic Center](https://www.deadlistening.com/2008/05/1979-may-5-baltimore-civic-center.html) [22]
